name: Growth-Stage / Scale-Up
description: Series B to Series D. 50-500 employees. Product-market fit found, scaling the business.
key_challenges: System migration (building what you wished for)
org_structure: Functional departments emerging. VPs hired. Middle layer forms. Still relatively flat compared to enterprise.
decision_making: Shift from founder-driven to leader-driven with delegation. Weekly exec staff meetings. OKRs adopted.
hiring: Specialist hires begin. First dedicated HR/recruiting team. Levels and bands introduced. Performance reviews start.
process_maturity: Process introduced deliberately — not too early, not too late. Playbooks written. CRM and tooling stack matures.
compensation: Market-rate salaries + equity (now real paper value). Benefit packages compete with big company tiers.
